objective: Repair the exact production web Advertise submit error 'expo-file-system.readAsStringAsync is not available on web' for both creative photo/video and optional private payment screenshot upload without changing Android runtime, app monetization/approval contracts or credentials.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub Main 03e920798cb5e1401fbbc283add39ac8d63ff8db already deployed to Expo Hosting buklod.expo.app at deployment r9d28ba7ik and Android production OTA 01a1b67f-83aa-7e6c-93d7-ed8f7daa4ba8 with runtime 1.3.2. `src/app/advertise/index.tsx` calls FileSystem.readAsStringAsync for all platforms, which is unsupported on web as confirmed by user's live submission error. Expo ImagePicker SDK defines asset.file as a web-only File and Supabase Storage accepts browser File/Blob. Existing native decoder yields ArrayBuffer and must remain intact. Source-only fix does not need schema migration or EAS secrets.
chosenApproach: Introduce a small hook-free platform upload-body reader. On web, use ImagePickerAsset.file (browser File) or fetch the selected blob URI, validating non-empty bytes and size. On native, retain existing expo-file-system/legacy readAsStringAsync and base64-arraybuffer decode via lazy callback. Use one shared uploadAsset flow for paid-ad-media creative and paid-ad-payment proof, keeping paths user-scoped, Supabase content-type and upsert:false, with limits aligned to actual storage buckets.
selectionRationale: The failure is due to invoking a native-only method on web, not missing native linking. A platform-specific byte acquisition avoids unnecessary binary changes and allows large files to upload without expensive browser base64 conversion. No approval or payment status logic changes.
alternativeApproaches: Link or rebuild native module in browser: rejected, web has no native filesystem API.
Read all browser files as base64 using FileReader: rejected, memory-heavy for videos and unnecessary with Supabase browser File support.
Change Android upload to browser Blob for all platforms: rejected because Supabase RN Blob upload compatibility is not guaranteed.
Alter or expose payment proof bucket: rejected; private admin-reviewed screenshots remain private.
preserveBehaviors: Existing Android V28 runtime 1.3.2, native base64-to-ArrayBuffer behavior and EAS configuration untouched
Photo/video creative and private proof stay in their original separate buckets with original owner-scoped paths, RLS and no overwrite
Campaign always inserts pending review with payment pending, no automatic activation
Existing Admin paid campaign review, manual verification and 30-day approval start preserved
Do not perform duplicate submission retries or alter real payment records
No Android OTA required if only web browser code path changes; publish to Expo Hosting web after mandatory QA
Previously passing advertiser/admin contract tests remain covered by existing CI without being misdeclared as changed source files.
acceptanceChecks: Web File from ImagePicker goes to Supabase Storage without readAsStringAsync invocation
Older blob URI web picker can upload via fetch/blob fallback; missing/empty blob yields actionable error
Native path returns original decoded ArrayBuffer with no browser fetch
Shared upload path handles advertisement photo/video and private payment proof
TypeScript and web compatibility/export pass; immutable production web source and deployment verified
Existing payment and campaign state unchanged
